UPDATE SA MGA KALSADA SA MANILA

Humupa na ang baha sa ilang kalsada sa Manila ngayong Linggo, July 20, matapos ang pag-ulang dala ng Bagyong #CrisingPH at hanging Habagat.

Sa 5 a.m. heavy rainfall warning ng DOST-PAGASA, nakataas ang yellow warning level sa Metro Manila.

📸: Manila DRRM Office/Facebook

data.raw_text:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 22 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Enhanced Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 8:00 AM, 20 July 2025(Sunday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales, Tarlac, Pampanga, Bataan, Bulacan, Metro Manila, Cavite, Rizal, Batangas(Balayan, Tuy, Nasugbu, Lian, Calatagan) and Laguna(Calamba, Binan, San Pedro, Santa Rosa, Cabuyao).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Nueva Ecija and Quezon within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Laguna(Alaminos, Bay, Calauan, Liliw, Los Banos, Luisiana, Magdalena, Majayjay, Nagcarlan, Pagsanjan, Pila, Rizal, San Pablo, Santa Cruz, Victoria, Cavinti, Famy, Kalayaan, Lumban, Mabitac, Paete, Pakil, Pangil, Santa Maria, Siniloan) and Batangas(Agoncillo, Alitagtag, Balete, Batangas City, Bauan, Calaca, Tanauan, Cuenca, Ibaan, Laurel, Lemery, Lipa, Lobo, Mabini, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Padre Garcia, Rosario, San Jose, San Juan, San Luis, San Nicolas, San Pascual, Santa Teresita, Santo Tomas, Taal, Talisay, Taysan, Tingloy) which may persist within 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
